Kankakee River Environmental Condition Inventory Dashboard: Continuous Water Quality Monitoring – DRAFT v1.13

Continuous Eureka multiprobe measurements collected from two survey kayaks during the 2025 Kankakee River inventory.

This first working version preserves all measurements. “Most Representative Data” hides readings with specific conductivity below 0.2 mS/cm or dissolved oxygen at or below 0.1 mg/L, which may indicate that sensors were not fully in water or were producing artifacts.

Display Options

Data availability: Dissolved oxygen (DO), pH, and chlorophyll a measurements are available only for the river-segment surveys completed on May 7 and May 9, 2025. For later survey dates, please refer to the Verbal Observation Water Quality Dashboard, where less frequent but still representative measurements of these parameters were recorded.

Interpretation Notes

The chart uses actual Eastern Time timestamps. Lines are separated by surveyor and are not drawn across different survey dates.
Map and chart colors are scaled to the minimum and maximum values in the current filtered view; they are not regulatory categories.
Missing parameter measurements remain in the source workbook but are omitted from the map, chart, and statistics for that parameter.
Laboratory-corrected nitrate is displayed as mg/L-N.
Estimated Speed is calculated from the distance and elapsed time since the previous record within the same survey date, river segment, surveyor, and probe sequence. The first record in each sequence has no estimated speed.
